[[File:Cecil_B_de_Mille_in_The_Greatest_Show_on_Earth_trailer.jpg | thumb | right | alt=Screenshot of a man in a suit | Cecil B. DeMille won Best Director for ''The Greatest Show on Earth'' and the film won Best Picture]]
The '''10th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] for [[1952 in film|1952]] films, were held on February 26, 1953, at the [[Ambassador Hotel (Los Angeles)|Ambassador Hotel]] in [[Los Angeles]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Villanueva |first=Armando |date=2022-11-01 |title=1953: A Year for Song and Dance |url=https://goldenglobes.com/articles/1953-a-year-for-song-and-dance/ |access-date=2025-08-04 |website=Golden Globes |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Winners and Nominees==

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama|Best Motion Picture – Drama]]===
Source:<ref>{{Cite web |title=Winners & Nominees |url=https://goldenglobes.com/winners-nominees/ |access-date=2025-08-04 |website=Golden Globes |language=en-US}}</ref>

''' ''[[The Greatest Show on Earth (film)|The Greatest Show on Earth]]'' '''
*''[[Come Back, Little Sheba (1952 film)|Come Back, Little Sheba]]''
*''[[The Happy Time]]''
*''[[High Noon]]''
*''[[The Thief (1952 film)|The Thief]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy|Best Motion Picture – Comedy or Musical]]===
''' ''[[With a Song in My Heart (film)|With a Song in My Heart]]'' '''
*''[[Hans Christian Andersen (film)|Hans Christian Andersen]]''
*''[[I'll See You in My Dreams (1951 film)|I'll See You in My Dreams]]''
*''[[Singin' in the Rain]]''
*''[[Stars and Stripes Forever (film)|Stars and Stripes Forever]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama|Best Performance by an Actor in a Motion Picture – Drama]]===
''' [[Gary Cooper]] – ''[[High Noon]]'' '''
*[[Charles Boyer]] – ''[[The Happy Time]]''
*[[Ray Milland]] – ''[[The Thief (1952 film)|The Thief]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama|Best Performance by an Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama]]===
''' [[Shirley Booth]] – ''[[Come Back, Little Sheba (1952 film)|Come Back, Little Sheba]]'' '''
*[[Joan Crawford]] – ''[[Sudden Fear]]''
*[[Olivia de Havilland]] – ''[[My Cousin Rachel (1952 film)|My Cousin Rachel]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Musical or Comedy|Best Performance by an Actor in a Motion Picture – Comedy or Musical]]===
''' [[Donald O'Connor]] – ''[[Singin' in the Rain]]'' '''
*[[Danny Kaye]] – ''[[Hans Christian Andersen (film)|Hans Christian Andersen]]'' 
*[[Clifton Webb]] – ''[[Stars and Stripes Forever (film)|Stars and Stripes Forever]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actress – Motion Picture Comedy or Musical|Best Performance by an Actress in a Motion Picture – Comedy or Musical]]===
''' [[Susan Hayward]] – ''[[With a Song in My Heart (film)|With a Song in My Heart]]'' '''
*[[Katharine Hepburn]] – ''[[Pat and Mike]]''
*[[Ginger Rogers]] – ''[[Monkey Business (1952 film)|Monkey Business]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture|Best Performance by an Actor in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture]]===
''' [[Millard Mitchell]] – ''[[My Six Convicts]]'' '''
*[[Kurt Kasznar]] – ''[[The Happy Time]]''
*[[Gilbert Roland]] – ''[[The Bad and the Beautiful]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress – Motion Picture|Best Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture]]===
''' [[Katy Jurado]] – ''[[High Noon]]'' '''
*[[Mildred Dunnock]] – ''[[Viva Zapata!]]''
*[[Gloria Grahame]] – ''[[The Bad and the Beautiful]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Director|Best Direction – Motion Picture]]===
''' [[Cecil B. DeMille]] – ''[[The Greatest Show on Earth (film)|The Greatest Show on Earth]]'' '''
*[[Richard Fleischer]] – ''[[The Happy Time]]''
*[[John Ford]] – ''[[The Quiet Man]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Screenplay|Best Screenplay – Motion Picture]]===
''' ''[[5 Fingers]]'' – [[Michael Wilson (writer)|Michael Wilson]] '''
*''[[High Noon]]'' – [[Carl Foreman]]
*''[[The Thief (1952 film)|The Thief]]'' – [[Clarence Greene]]

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Original Score|Best Music, Original Score – Motion Picture]]===
''' ''[[High Noon]]'' – [[Dimitri Tiomkin]] '''
*''[[Ivanhoe]]'' – [[Miklós Rózsa]]
*''[[The Quiet Man]]'' – [[Victor Young]]
